**About Us – Faded Archive**  
Faded Archive is a made‑to‑order tee shop based in Manchester, where we turn your ideas into high‑quality, soft‑wear garments. Each shirt is printed on demand, giving you a unique, perfectly fitted piece that reflects your style. We source premium, sustainably produced fabrics and use eco‑friendly inks, so you can wear your statement with pride and peace of mind.  

Our design team stays ahead of the trends, offering everything from minimalist slogans to vibrant artwork, all hand‑picked to echo the creativity that drives us.  

**Logo Colour Suggestion**  
A muted, charcoal‑grey hue would complement our understated brand while standing out on any shirt colour. Let me know if you’d prefer a different shade.
